Setup.Name: Advanced XPath
Setup.Description: An advanced example on how to parse an xml paylog using child indices to create detailed metrics manually.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Read only the second value of an array using XmlPath"
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/data"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Processor.Temperature"
          Description: "The current processor temperature."
          Instrument: Gauge
          Unit: "C"
          Attributes:
            - Key: "test"
              Value: "value"
          Value: "XMLPATH('/Processors/Processor[2]/Temperature')"
